## The problem
Collaboration between nursing teams is treated as important but is rarely measured. Staffing and rostering data record who works when, not who actually works together, so "more collaboration" stays a slogan rather than something you can track, compare, or link to outcomes.

## The approach
I developed the Structured Collaboration Index — a method that derives collaboration intensity in multi-team systems directly from scheduling data, turning ordinary rosters into a quantitative measure of how much teams overlap and work together. It gives workforce research and hospital management a concrete, repeatable metric in place of a subjective judgement.
